messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Apr 02, 2024, ABDELATIF MESSAOUDI via AMBER wrote:
>
>I run pre-command to create non-solvated file from solvated complex
>(cpx.top):
>
>Error: parmed cannot be found!
Your repeated messages (all with the same error) are not going to be solved
until you find the reason why your initial python installation failed. Try
to provide the information requested here:
http://archive.ambermd.org/202403/0179.html
You might also try a completely fresh install, even on a different machine.
...dac
